segments.ja261:1.1: Yathā kesā ca massū ca, chinnaṃ chinnaṃ virūhati;
segments.ja261:1.3: Evaṃ rūhatu te nāsā, padumaṃ dehi yācito.
segments.ja261:2.1: Yathā sāradikaṃ bījaṃ, khette vuttaṃ virūhati;
segments.ja261:2.3: Evaṃ rūhatu te nāsā, padumaṃ dehi yācito.
segments.ja261:3.1: Ubhopi palapantete [vilapantete (syā. ka.)], api padmāni dassati;
segments.ja261:3.3: Vajjuṃ vā te na vā vajjuṃ, natthi nāsāya rūhanā;
segments.ja261:3.5: Dehi samma padumāni, ahaṃ yācāmi yācitoti.
